realm_domain.description: Base DNS domain of the IPA realm (e.g., 'example.com'). Will be lowercased.

realm_name.description: Kerberos realm name (e.g., 'EXAMPLE'). Will be uppercased.

server_hostnames.description: List of IPA server hostnames to use for authentication and directory operations.

dns_discovery.description: If enabled, use DNS SRV records to auto-discover IPA servers.

ssl_verify.description: If enabled, verify IPA server SSL/TLS certificates using the CA certificate.

ca_cert_path.description: Absolute path to the IPA CA certificate file used for server validation.

ssh_key_algorithm.description: Comma-separated list of allowed SSH key algorithms for host key enrollment (e.g., 'ssh-rsa,ssh-ed25519').

update_dns.description: If enabled, automatically register/update the host's SSHFP DNS records.

sssd_enabled.description: Enable integration with SSSD for identity, authentication, and authorization.

nss_enabled.description: Enable integration with nsswitch for local name resolution (users, groups, hosts).

sudo_enabled.description: Enable support for centralized sudo rules from IPA.

autofs_enabled.description: Enable support for centralized automounter maps from IPA.

ccache_enabled.description: Enable Kerberos credential caching (required for interactive and batch auth).

ipv6_enabled.description: If enabled, attempt IPv6 communication to IPA servers before falling back to IPv4.

connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for network connections to IPA servers.

verbose_logging.description: Enable verbose debug logging in client tools (not recommended in production).

enroll_keytab.description: If enabled, enroll a host keytab (required for SPNEGO, HTTP, and other service principals).

ssh_enroll_enabled.description: If enabled, enroll the host’s SSH public key to IPA (for trust and remote login).

advertised_hostname.description: Custom FQDN to advertise as the host’s identity in IPA; leave blank to use system hostname.
